scope: Final combined local CI-selected root regression gate for the frozen native timer-bootstrap and tab-selector candidates.

sourceBinding.diffHashMethod: SHA256 of git diff --binary --no-ext-diff HEAD over application, tests, scripts, backend, web/admin, workflow and package/config scopes; docs excluded. New untracked test files are independently covered by the frozen source hashes and full test manifest.

standaloneReports.countNote: Standalone assertions are separate from formal Node test counters. Do not add file-wrapper cases or these 33 checks to the formal count.

unchangedChecksNotRepeated: Dedicated backend Node and RPC authorization jobs
limitations: This is a local root gate using Node 24.22.1, while isolated PR 6 CI used Node 22.23.4. It is separate from a new CI/native run of this candidate.

Every CI-selected root test file ran in its own Node process with NODE_TEST_CONTEXT removed so actual internal counters are visible. The standalone auth program is reported separately instead of being counted as an extra file-wrapper test.
The isolated PR 6 green quality run verifies the earlier one-file harness fix. It does not itself verify these later timer-bootstrap/tab-selector source changes.

The root suite contains synthetic native host, transport and database fixtures. It does not establish full Simulator/Emulator accessibility exposure, physical-device behavior, hosted provider delivery or production performance.
A new full native app build and flow is still required for the changed candidate. The current iPhone run and original Android failure remain separately source-bound evidence.
